US-Iran peace talks continue with mediator meetings and pending US response

The Iranian foreign minister Araghchi met Qatari mediators in New York, where Tehran said it had received a U.S. response to its proposal and Araghchi was told to leave after the talks failed. Mediators are continuing to work on a U.S.-Iran deal but face major hurdles, and Araghchi said he is waiting for definitive opinions on a seven‑day cease‑fire proposal. The Iranian delegation is scheduled to return to Tehran on Tuesday.
